label: telemetry-publish
info:
Telemetry Publish Flow (FR1)

Publishes normalized sensor telemetry from local Mosquitto to ThingsBoard cloud via MQTT TLS.

Input topic: nexus/+/+/telemetry (local Mosquitto)
Output topic: v1/devices/me/telemetry (ThingsBoard cloud MQTT TLS)
Output format: {"ts": <epoch_ms>, "values": {"key": value}}

Connection: MQTT TLS 1.2+ on port 8883 with access token authentication.
Authentication: ThingsBoard Access Token as MQTT username.

name: Flow: telemetry-publish (FR1, NFR2)
info:
Telemetry Publish Flow

Purpose: Forward normalized sensor telemetry from local Mosquitto to ThingsBoard cloud via MQTT TLS.

Input:
- Local MQTT: nexus/+/+/telemetry (normalized by protocol-normalization flow)

Output:
- ThingsBoard MQTT TLS: v1/devices/me/telemetry
- ThingsBoard attributes: v1/devices/me/attributes (connection status)

Connection:
- Host: ${TB_CLOUD_HOST}
- Port: ${TB_CLOUD_MQTT_PORT} (default 8883)
- Auth: Access Token as MQTT username
- TLS: One-way TLS 1.2+ (server cert verification)
- Client ID: nexus-gw-${ZONE_ID}
- QoS: 1 (at-least-once delivery)
- LWT: {"cloud_connected": false} on v1/devices/me/attributes

Error handling: catch node logs all errors in format:
[telemetry-publish] {error_type}: {message}
